title: NFL binary moneyline high-band calibration — Phase-1 same-set cell + map-family selection, Phase-2 gated verdict
gated: adoption-style: Phase 2 runs only behind Phase 1's computed gate; verdict computed, not narrated
scope: nfl-backend + data_delivery ONLY; READ-ONLY over production code (no engine/pricing/feature change; FEATURE_COLUMNS byte-untouched); the only production-code edit is the targeted retention-prefix pin in master_pipeline.py

provenance.audit: nfl_margin_audit_3e8c8a510f04.json (c1a7c12) — binary Platt 70-80 band pred 0.7485 vs actual 0.6754 (n=191, ECE 0.0731); raw axis at its own band 0.747 vs 0.800; DIFFERENT game sets — same-set cell unproven until now
provenance.universe: shared 1,376-game decided OOF (markets kind==oof 20260904: pooled 2021-24 n=1,091 + sealed 2025 n=285); binary axes from nfl_predictions_history_20260904.csv (raw = home_win_prob_model, published = home_win_prob_model_calibrated)
provenance.production_map: the deployed/published Platt twin = the SEALED global logistic on logit(raw), a=1.276336 b=0.121988, fit on ALL pooled pre-holdout OOF rows (n=1107 per the moneyline record, incl. playoff weeks); the walk itself is 88 folds over the pooled 1,107 (2019-2024 train, 2021-2024 val weeks, 2025 = sealed hold-out, never in any fit or calibration map)
provenance.validated_reproduction: fitting family (a) on the CSV pooled adaptive-blend raw reproduces the published map to 3e-5 (a=1.276365, b=0.121987) and the sealed metrics exactly (ll 0.6249 / ECE 0.0745 == nfl_moneyline_v1_20260904 sealed model_platt) — the read-only deployed-path measurements ARE the production numbers

phase1_same_set_cell.branch_finding: the RAW ensemble is well-calibrated on exactly the games Platt pushes into 70-80 (raw 0.6815 vs actual 0.6754); the deployed global logistic (slope a=1.276) over-stretches the raw 0.66-0.72 region to ~0.73-0.78. Reverse cell: on games raw scores 70-80 (actual 0.80) Platt pushes to 0.8174 — approximately right there (under-confidence at the raw top end is what the global slope is compensating for, and the fixed 2-parameter slope over-corrects the mid-high band).
phase1_same_set_cell.deeper_statement: the miscalibration is introduced by the CALIBRATION LAYER (map shape), not by the ensemble: a recalibration family with LOCAL flexibility can recover genuine calibration at the band. This is NOT the Branch-A case (ensemble overconfidence) — no feature/availability lever is implicated by this cell.

phase1_sub_band_splits.finding: the over-confidence WORSE NS toward the top of the band (ECE 0.051 at 70-75, 0.102 at 75-80) — consistent with a slope over-correction growing with logit distance from the map's anchor, diagnostic only (SE +-4.8pp at n~95).

phase1_band_decomposition.finding: the distortion appears BOTH in-sample on the map's own fit pool (0.0576) and out-of-sample on sealed 2025 (0.1337) — a genuine shape limitation of the 2-parameter logistic, not a fit artifact.

phase1_map_family_selection.rows: pooled pre-holdout OOF n=1107 (moneyline walk pool incl. playoff weeks), 88 fold-weeks
phase1_map_family_selection.protocol: nested per-fold: each fold's map fit on STRICTLY-EARLIER folds' (raw, actual) pairs only — the production nested-Platt geometry; identity fallback when <10 prior rows / single class; raw axis = the CSV adaptive-blend (documented delta: the record's pooled cal_po metrics use the fold-loop STATIC blend raw; the deployed map and every Phase-2 band leg target the adaptive blend the CSV carries)
phase1_map_family_selection.family_choice_rule: best joint band-ECE profile, preferring Platt within 0.005 (parsimony). Family (c) is 0.026 better than (a) on the target band — beyond the 0.005 parsimony band — so the chosen family is c_pchip_monotone_spline (b_isotonic loses logloss +0.086 and under-performs (a)/(c) on every band).
phase1_map_family_selection.finding: a locally flexible monotone map recovers the band (0.028 -> 0.002 nested) WITHOUT adjacent-band regression (60-70 and 80+ both improve) — consistent with Branch B.

phase2_projected_leg_table.basis: Phase-2 legs computed READ-ONLY at production fidelity — the map change rides on the committed pooled OOF outputs (validated bit-consistent with the moneyline record), so a full 88-fold ensemble re-run would re-derive identical numbers; no production code was changed. Deployed protocol = map fit on ALL pooled rows (the platt_sealed protocol); nested protocol = per-fold strictly-earlier fits (the record's pooled-calibrated convention). Sealed S1/S2 = chronological halves of the 285 sealed-2025 games by gameday (S1 n=142, S2 n=143; S2 = arbiter). NO prior NFL S1/S2 convention existed — defined here and recorded.

pooled_cal_logloss_no_regression_beyond_.note: BLOCKING — the logistic MLE is the logloss optimum of its family; a band-local map trades ~+0.013 pooled logloss for band honesty. 13x the +/-0.001 bar — deterministic, not noise.

pooled_cal_ece_improves_target_lt_0_02.note: improves by 0.0107 but the final value 0.0295 does not reach the < 0.02 target; deployed in-sample 0.0360 -> 0.0287 (also > 0.02)

platt_70_80_band_ece_lt_0_03_new_axis.note: BLOCKING on the out-of-sample reads (sealed 0.0421, S1 0.1213 > 0.03); only the nested pooled read clears it

adjacent_bands_no_regression_beyond_0_01.note: BLOCKING — sealed 80+ band ECE 0.0094 -> 0.1047 (+0.0953, n=20); the flexible map's flat tail over-corrects the highest-confidence games the global slope was protecting

pooled_cal_auc_flat_within_0_001.note: CONTRACT leg: every candidate family is strictly monotone -> rank-invariant -> AUC identical to the raw axis by construction; no AUC-improvement claim is made or expected

sealed_s1_s2_same_bands_s2_arbiter.note: the arbiter half S2 improves materially (ECE 0.1296 -> 0.0695; 70-80 band 0.162 -> 0.011) but S1 regresses (0.0674 -> 0.0826) — mixed, and the S1 regression plus the sealed-full legs above fail the blocking set

determinism.note: probe double-run byte-identical; map fits are deterministic (sklearn/scipy, no stochasticity)

worth_having_band_gain_gt_noise_over_3.note: the S2/band gains are large (0.026-0.15); not the binding constraint

phase2_projected_leg_table.family_a_status: platt refit == the current deployed map; cannot fix the deployed band (sealed 70-80 ECE 0.1337 > 0.03) — a same-family re-fit changes nothing.
phase2_projected_leg_table.family_b_status: isotonic degenerates on the out-of-sample axis (sealed 70-80 band ECE 0.7103 — step-function extrapolation) and costs +0.086 pooled logloss.
blocking_legs: pooled_cal_logloss regression +0.0129 > +/-0.001 (nested protocol, the record's pooled-calibrated convention)
70-80 band ECE on the NEW axis not < 0.03 out-of-sample (sealed 0.0421, S1 0.1213)

verdict_summary: Phase-1 gate PASSED (the miscalibration is real beyond noise and a locally flexible family fixes the band on pre-holdout), but Phase-2's own full blocking leg set fails for EVERY candidate family — the deployed global-logistic over-stretch at raw ~0.66-0.72 is a genuine 2-parameter shape limitation, and the only family that fixes it (monotone spline) trades pooled logloss (+0.013) and small-n top-band calibration to do so. Production Platt twin UNCHANGED. The calibration layer is the locus (Branch B); the ensemble itself is well-calibrated on the disputed games — this is an output-layer map-shape finding, NOT a feature/availability signal.
follow_on_options_noted_not_taken: a product-level decision to accept band-honesty at a pooled-logloss cost (relaxing the +/-0.001 pooled-cal-ll leg) — a decision for the user, out of scope here
a serve-time convention to quote the RAW axis (or a flatter local map) specifically above ~0.68 confidence while keeping the Platt twin elsewhere — schema/frontend implications, out of scope
revisit after more sealed-2025 data: the sealed 70-80/80+ bands sit at n=39/46 (S1/S2 ~8-29) — the spline tail behavior at 80+ is the least certain leg
